title: Veil-rays at Ruchbah Broken Glass Veil (lawless); verdigris curd sold at The Experiment
note: Beyond Voidborn space (orders F13). Seven veil-rays counted 2026-11-15 21:14 UTC by the frontier census. Flown by hand with an empty hold from 21:26 UTC: 0 kills, -77 cr of fuel, no damage; two ships of a large faction joined the fight within three minutes and our hunter fled (guidebook military.md, section 2). Back in the drone plan from 2026-11-15 23:28 UTC as a test with one ship, with `alone` (no fight where a ship that is not ours stands) and `requires.empty_hold` (orders.log ENT-007, block APOPHIS). Ranched like the home herds. 2026-11-16 09:12 UTC (Apophis): status off. The verdigris curd bid (330 cr x 50) left every station of our books between 07:08 and 07:51 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl) and has not come back; the seven drone veil-ray hunts made -1,851 cr in 21 runs from 07:05 UTC (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Back on when a curd bid of 100 cr or more reads again (the tool market); requires.bid on hunt routes is asked of Unity so that this happens by itself. 2026-11-16 13:09 UTC (Apophis): back on (orders.log ENT-014, block APOPHIS). The verdigris curd bid stood again at 330 cr x 50 at seven stations of our books from 12:07 to 12:21 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl). `requires.bid` names the curd bid of the sell station (100 cr, 4 units): the dispatcher closes the route while a book read within the hour shows it gone and opens it when a docked ship reads it back; `min_bid` 100 so that every bid that opens the route also takes the curd. The loss stop holds it until its losing runs of 07:05 to 09:20 UTC leave the six-hour window. 2026-11-16 18:33 UTC (Apophis): standing work, `requires.bid` out. Orders ENT-017 (block APOPHIS): where no bid stands for a kill's goods they go into storage; a station takes 34,832 verdigris curd and we hold 37 (base_plan, 18:30 UTC). The hunter sells the curd where its sell station bids 100 cr or more and stores it there otherwise; the herd floor (min_creatures 4) and one hunter keep the herd. The curd bid read 0 at every sell station of these hunts at 18:26 UTC (loot_bids). 2026-11-17 08:14 UTC (Apophis): `alone` "pirates": it leaves only for a pirate or a pilot filed hostile (hunt.py e138722); 61 of 161 drone hunts from 04:12 to 08:10 UTC left for a stranger who never fired (data/routes/runs.jsonl), and no ship of ours was fired on at a hunt (errors.log), so the limit is lifted (F13); lift_to 1: one hunter or guard to a place (F9, orders ENT-031 task 4 a). 2026-11-17 16:14 UTC (Apophis): min_bid 100 -> 5000: verdigris curd is held back whole for copper piping (surplus.py reserve: 607 of 607 held), so no bid takes it (rule F24); the curd and carapace go into storage. 2026-11-22 00:08 UTC (Apophis): gift_to trader (queue.log ENT-200, ENT-201: strict classes, Suggi D244): with the switch on, the loot goes into the trader named for sell_at; off, nothing changes.
